title: Tiger cub holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Tiger body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="24" ry="20" fill="#FF8C1A"/>
  <!-- Tiger belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="15" ry="13" fill="#FFD699"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="43" r="20" fill="#FF8C1A"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="28" r="7" fill="#FF8C1A"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="28" r="4" fill="#FFB366"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="28" r="7" fill="#FF8C1A"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="28" r="4" fill="#FFB366"/>
  <!-- Face white area -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="49" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#FFD699"/>
  <!-- Stripes on head -->
  <rect x="46" y="24" width="2.5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <rect x="51.5" y="24" width="2.5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <rect x="30" y="38" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <rect x="29.5" y="43" width="4.5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <rect x="66" y="38" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <rect x="66" y="43" width="4.5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="42" r="3.5" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="42" r="3.5" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="44.2" cy="40.8" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58.2" cy="40.8" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <path d="M48 47 L52 47 L50 49.5 Z" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M46 50 Q50 53 54 50" fill="none" stroke="#5C2E00" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1="36" y1="46" x2="28" y2="44" stroke="#5C2E00" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="36" y1="49" x2="28" y2="49" stroke="#5C2E00" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="64" y1="46" x2="72" y2="44" stroke="#5C2E00" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="64" y1="49" x2="72" y2="49" stroke="#5C2E00" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Stripes on body -->
  <rect x="34" y="60" width="3" height="10" rx="1.2" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <rect x="63" y="60" width="3" height="10" rx="1.2" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <rect x="30" y="66" width="3" height="8" rx="1.2" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <rect x="67" y="66" width="3" height="8" rx="1.2" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <!-- Paws holding heart -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="66" r="6" fill="#FF8C1A"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="66" r="6" fill="#FF8C1A"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="66" r="3.5" fill="#FFD699"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="66" r="3.5" fill="#FFD699"/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d="M50 56 C50 56, 42 52, 42 58 C42 64, 50 70, 50 70 C50 70, 58 64, 58 58 C58 52, 50 56, 50 56 Z" fill="#FF3355"/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <path d="M46 56.5 C46 56.5, 44.5 55.5, 44.5 57.5 C44.5 59, 46 60.5, 46 60.5" fill="none" stroke="#FF99AA" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M72 78 Q84 74 82 64" fill="none" stroke="#FF8C1A" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="64" r="3" fill="#5C2E00"/>
</svg>
